description:
[Merchant] **Replace all** of a placement's airing rules with this list, all or nothing: when any rule is refused, nothing is saved and each refused rule is listed by its index. An empty list removes every rule. Suited to loading an agency's schedule in one call.

**Endpoint:** PUT /products/{productId}/placements/{placementId}/airings (PRM plan)

placementId.description: The placement's ID: pl + 8 letters or digits, e.g. pl7e4rCToG

productId.description: The product's ID: pr + 8 letters or digits, e.g. pr7e4rCToG

rules.description: The complete new set of airing rules, up to 100

daysOfWeek.description: WEEKLY: the days it airs on

endDate.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 366 days after startDate. Omit for open-ended

excludedDates.description: Days it does not air, YYYY-MM-DD

expectedAudience.description: Expected audience per airing, for your own planning

monthDays.description: MONTHLY by date: days of the month. A day a month lacks is skipped

monthWeek.description: MONTHLY by weekday: which week, -1 for the last. Use with monthWeekday

repeatEvery.description: Every N days, weeks or months. Default 1

startDate.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the rule's time zone

timeZone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Sofia. Default: the product's

windows.description: Time windows on each day it airs, local to the time zone: 1 to 24, each up to 6 hours

end.description: HH:mm, at most 6 hours after start. At or before start runs past midnight

useSandbox.description: Use the sandbox (the default) rather than production

name: payware_products_replace_airings
